card.name: Verbs in psychiatric warning statements
card.fires_on: Short linking or helper words (is, may, occur, and) in warning sections on psychiatric or sleep-related drug effects. They sit just before a hedged claim about cause or occurrence.

modes.label: Verb on whether symptoms relate to illness
modes.description: A helper verb such as "may" or "occur" in a sentence about whether suicidal thoughts or sleep behaviors are linked to treatment or illness.
modes.example: thoughts and behavior. Should suicidal thoughts and behavior emerge during treatment, the prescriber needs to consider whether the emergence of these symptoms in any given patient<< may>> be related to the illness being treated.
